# Pattern Library

25 reusable patterns distilled from both research reports. Each pattern file has YAML front matter (id, provenance, supporting references, suitable/unsuitable project types) and sections for UX goal, visual characteristics, interaction behavior, implementation, accessibility and performance.

Patterns are abstractions across several references – use them to compose original designs, never to copy a single site.
